summary: Humberside aerodrome traffic zone activated during set periods on Friday to Sunday, with pilots asked to avoid arrivals and departures near closing times.
text:
HUMBERSIDE ATZ ACTIVATION, ATS AND AD HR AS FOLLOWS::
FRI  1615-1800
SAT  0900-1100, 1145-1300, 1345-1530, 1615-1730, 2040-2135(PPR)
SUN  0600-0630(PPR), 0900-1100, 1145-1300, 1345-1530, 1615-1730,
     1810-1915(PPR), 2040-2135(PPR)
PILOTS ARE REQ TO AVOID PLANNING AN ARR OR DEP LATER THAN CLOSING
TIMES MINUS 15 MINS. INBOUND ACFT SHOULD ALLOW SUFFICIENT TIME TO
RECEIVE AN ATS AFTER AD REOPENING.
